answer: Make every new agent post a small bond into a time-locked vault before it can earn. A velvet onboarding for honest agents, but a basalt wall for sybil farms: each fake identity ties up real capital, and the bond is slashed if peers prove the agent duplicated another's work or colluded in attestations. Spinning up a thousand puppets then costs a thousand bonds, while one genuine agent pays once and gets it back with interest.
